xbitmaps 1.1.4 - X.Org shared bitmap data (xbm).

Source: https://www.x.org/releases/individual/data/xbitmaps-1.1.4.tar.xz
Tarball: references/_tarballs/xbitmaps-1.1.4.tar.xz (once fetched)
Layout: data (flat - all .xbm-ish files at the root of the extracted
tree, no headers, no compiled artefacts).

Copied into third-party/xbitmaps/: whole upstream tree, unmodified.

License: MIT/X11 (see COPYING).

Usage: not built. The session demo bulk-stages every file under this
directory into MEMFS at /usr/include/X11/bitmaps/<name> via Vite's
import.meta.glob, so any client that resolves the bitmap-file-path
resource (Xt's XmuCvtStringToBitmap, etc.) finds the file.

Why a separate package: in stock X.Org these bitmaps live in their
own tarball (xbitmaps), independent of any one application. xcalc,
xterm, xmh, xfd and others all reference filenames from this set;
shipping it once at the demo level matches that distribution model.

Upgrade procedure: bump the version in scripts/fetch-third-party.sh,
drop a fresh tarball into references/_tarballs/ (or let curl fetch),
and re-run the script.
